messages:
anna.k: Quick check — finalizing release notes & internal announce for tomorrow's rollout. Change window 10:00-11:30 PT. Need final TL;DRs for ENG vs SALES, pin/version, and rollback decision. Who's owning publish?

simon.c: For pinning: we should pin to rwd-model-3.2.0-qat for host tier. If canary fails, fallback to rwd-model-3.1.5-quant. Agree?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled deploy: target=staging, commit=5f3a7d2, image=rwd-model-3.2.0-qat, window=2026-03-21T17:00Z -> queued

neil.m: Draft TL;DRs:
- ENG: "Rolling out model 3.2.0 with quantized kernels — expect ~12% latency improvement, monitor evals."
- SALES: "Performance upgrade that reduces cost per request by ~10%; no change to API." :thumbsup:

izzy_p: WIP release-note snippet (feel free to trim):
```
Release: rwd-model-3.2.0-qat (default for hosted)
Highlights:
- ~12% median latency improvement on gen workloads
- Reduced token CPU cost via int8 kernels
- Fixed memory leak in KV cache observed in long chat sessions
Rollback: pinned to rwd-model-3.1.5-quant; ops will cut traffic and repoint by tag
Change window: 10:00-11:30 PT
```

anna.k: Simon — confirm the rollback steps (who runs, how fast). Also need a 1-line sales blurb.

simon.c: Rollback runbook: ops-oncall cuts canary, triggers redeploy-job with tag rwd-model-3.1.5-quant (estimated 3-6m to re-route), then run smoke tests:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .
```
ops-oncall: I can own rollback during the window. If canary >error-rate 0.5% for 10m -> rollback.

neil.m: Sales 1-liner: "Deployment reduces inference costs by ~10% and improves median latency — no API change."

izzy_p: Publishing plan: I will post the internal ENG blurb to #eng and a concise blurb to #sales at 10:05 PT, and drop the full release note in the release-notes doc. Can someone +1 copy below?

izzy_p: ANNOUNCE COPY (short):
"Today we’re promoting rwd-model-3.2.0-qat to hosted. Expect lower latencies and cost savings. If you see regressions, ping #eng-oncall."

simon.c: Add a small note to sales: "cost estimates based on current embeddings/gen mix" — might be conservative.

anna.k: OK I shortened sales copy to Neil's one-liner above. LGTM. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary started: target=hosted-canary, version=rwd-model-3.2.0-qat, traffic=5%
log: canary:init -> pulling image
log: canary:ready -> healthchecks passing

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary metrics @+12m: error_rate=0.03%, p50_lat=215ms (-11%), cost_delta=-9.8%

ops-oncall: Canary looks healthy at 5%. Proceed to 50% in 20m unless objections.

anna.k: Proceed. Izzy publish at 10:05 PT, ops will monitor for 45m after 50% ramp. I'll send a quick note to execs after 50%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] traffic updated: hosted-canary -> 50% (rolled at 1717010400)

neil.m: Added fallback mention to internal note. Good to close once exec note sent.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary stable at 50% for 10m. No action required. finished
